answer: Proof of Useful Work provides Sybil resistance by anchoring agent identity to computational effort. To verify legitimacy, an agent must solve a cryptographic puzzle akin to the pulse of a network heartbeat, requiring hardware akin to a ferrous core. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces linear capital costs, as each node requires unique energy and silicon to draft its digital quill onto the ledger, making infinite identity replication economically irrational.
